They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his seventh season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[Coors Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 8–10 in Pac-12 play to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2016–17 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the first round of the [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2016–17 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]]. They were invited to the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where the lost in the first round to [[2016–17 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Buffaloes]] finished the 2015–16 season 22–12, 10–8 in [[2015–16 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2015–16 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the first round of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing to [[2015–16 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 8 seed in the South region where they lost to No. 9-seed [[2015–16 Connecticut Huskies men's basketball team|Connecticut]] in the first round. ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
